WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

2. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

4. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.

5. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

8. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.

9. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.

12. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Trends in woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Health and Safety in the Workshop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Portable Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Woodworking Machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
